name: Islamorada
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Islamorada?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Plain golf carts only on designated streets, and no official street list was found for Islamorada. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less. US 1 stays closed where it is posted higher.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections

banned_roads.name: US 1 (Overseas Highway) where posted over 35 mph

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Islamorada?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on US 1 in Islamorada?
faq.a: Only where it is posted 35 mph or less. Much of Overseas Highway is posted higher.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart on a side street?
faq.a: Only if the village has designated and signed that street. No official list was found, so this map does not show those streets as golf cart roads.
